Stated before the build; no board reading was consulted.

composition.rule: np.where(airport in exp-036 keep, head, v7), then + s*(stack-5 - it)

airport_hold.rule: serve form 2' at an airport only where it gains on all three folds AND its own tail rows meet the registered clause (y > 3600 clean, RMSE against v7, 1 s allowance); v11 elsewhere
airport_hold.selection: POST-HOC on the three folds it is scored on, as exp-036's mask was; discovery evidence, not a passed gate

tail_hold.rule: np.where(p_v11 < 3600, form 2', v11) -- the SERVED predictor selects, never the label

endpoint: paired all-row January/July MSE at the ranking month shares {'july_loo': 0.5571321275602379, 'january': 0.4428678724397621}; clean and december reported separately
intervals: block bootstrap over calendar days shared across airports, 2000 draws, seed 7; 3-day and 7-day widths as sensitivity
